title: 第28章 步法课代表
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
周一早上，安槐把步法书和笔记交给苏念念的时候，她坐在座位上翻了三分钟就开始两眼放光。

    “这个步法跟断岳拳简直绝配！你看这个第二式的横移路线，跟我第三式的侧切发力完全同向！”

    安槐在旁边喝水，不紧不慢地嗯了一声。

    “笔记我写了标注，红色的是重点，蓝色的是容易出错的地方。”

    苏念念翻到笔记那几页，眼睛从放光变成了闪烁。

    “你这个笔记也太详细了吧，连常见的错误姿势都画了图解？你什么时候画的？”

    “昨晚。”

    苏念念抬头看了一眼他的黑眼圈，嘴角抽了一下。

    “你又熬夜了。”

    “没熬太晚。”

    “你撒谎的时候右边眉毛会微微往上挑，你知道吗？”

    安槐下意识地控制了一下自己的眉毛。

    苏念念冷笑了一声。“来不及了，已经挑过了。”

    她伸手在他脸上捏了一下，冰凉的触感让她的手指多停留了两秒。

    “下次再这么熬夜，我让我妈断你的排骨汤供应。”

    “老大恕罪。”

    苏念念哼了一声，把笔记小心地夹进自己的课本里。

    下午放学后，两人去了练功房。

    安槐花了四十分钟教苏念念短距突进步的基础三式。

    这本步法的核心在于“短距离内的极速变向”，配合断岳拳的爆发型发力，简直是为苏念念量身定做的。

    苏念念的学习速度一如既往地快，第一式走了八遍就找到了感觉，第二式十二遍，第三式卡了一会儿，但在安槐提示她“重心再压低两寸”之后也通了。

    到第二十遍的时候，她把三式连起来跑了一遍。

    脚步轻快，方向变化干脆利落，最后一步切入近身距离的时候，身体已经蓄好了断岳拳的发力姿态。

    安槐在旁边看着，满意地点了点头。

    “怎么样？”苏念念扭头看他。

    “快了很多。”

    “有多快？”

    安槐想了想。

    “你用这套步法切入的速度，比你之前快了大约四成，如果再打磨一周，配合回流掌和断岳拳连起来，同级别没人挡得住你。”

    苏念念的嘴角翘得能挂住月亮。

    她走过来伸手去揉安槐的脑袋，踮了下脚才够到顶。

    “我的好小弟。”

    安槐配合地弯腰。

    银灰色的发丝从她指缝间滑过，苏念念的手指在他头顶停了几秒，揉得比平时温柔了一些。

    安槐察觉到了力度的变化，但什么都没说。

    练功房门口忽然传来声音。

    “安槐同学在吗？”
content_en:
On Monday morning, when An Huai handed the footwork book and notes to Su Niannian, she sat in her seat and turned over them for three minutes before her eyes started to shine.

"This footwork is a perfect match for Duan Yue Quan! Look at the lateral movement of this second form, which is exactly the same direction as the side cutting force of my third form!"

An Huai was drinking water next to him and hummed unhurriedly.

"I marked the notes. The red ones are the key points, and the blue ones are the places where mistakes are easy to make."

Su Niannian turned to the pages of the notebook, and her eyes changed from shining to twinkling.

"Your notes are too detailed. You even drew diagrams of common wrong postures? When did you draw them?"

"Last night."

Su Niannian raised her head and glanced at the dark circles under his eyes, and the corners of her mouth twitched.

"You stayed up late again."

"Didn't stay up too late."

"Did you know that your right eyebrow raises slightly when you lie?"

An Huai subconsciously controlled his eyebrows.

Su Niannian sneered."It's too late, I've already picked it."

She stretched out her hand and pinched his face, and the cold touch made her fingers stay for two more seconds.

"Next time you stay up late like this, I'll ask my mother to cut off your supply of pork rib soup."

"Boss, please forgive me."

Su Niannian snorted and carefully put the notes into her textbook.

After school in the afternoon, the two went to the practice room.

An Huai spent forty minutes teaching Su Niannian the basic three movements of short-distance sprint progress.

The core of this footwork lies in "extremely rapid changes of direction within a short distance". Combined with the explosive force of Duanyue Fist, it is simply tailor-made for Su Niannian.

Su Niannian's learning speed was as fast as ever. She found the feeling after doing the first pose eight times, the second pose twelve times, and the third pose was stuck for a while, but she got it after An Huai reminded her to "lower the center of gravity two inches more."

By the twentieth time, she connected the three poses and ran them again.

His steps were brisk and his direction changes were crisp and clear. When he took the last step to get into close range, his body had already prepared the power of Duanyue Fist.

An Huai looked on and nodded with satisfaction.

"How is it?" Su Niannian turned to look at him.

"It's much faster."

"How fast?"

An Huai thought for a while.

"The speed you can cut with this set of footwork is about 40% faster than before. If you polish it for another week and combine it with the Return Palm and Duanyue Fist, no one at the same level can stop you."

The corners of Su Niannian's mouth were so raised that they could catch the moon.

She came over and reached out to rub An Huai's head, then stood on tiptoe to reach the top.

"My good little brother."

An Huai bent down in cooperation.

The silver-gray hair slipped between her fingers. Su Niannian's fingers paused on the top of his head for a few seconds, rubbing it more gently than usual.

An Huai noticed the change in intensity, but said nothing.

A voice suddenly came from the door of the practice room.

"Is An Huai here?"
